# Croom CPR p. 118 — Baptisms Mar – Jul 1877

**Source image:** `page_118_baptism_mar_jul1877.jpg` (this directory)
**NLI:** Croom parish 0881, microfilm 02427/07
**Coverage:** Mar 1877 – Jul 1877

## Status for our research

**CLEAN NEGATIVE for "Honoria/Nora filia Patricii Gleeson et Margaritae Moloney" baptism.** Two AI passes (Gemini + ChatGPT) plus a human-eyes pass; no entry for Patrick + Margaret Moloney parents in this window. See [[gleeson-nora-1876-1939-sister]].

## Load-bearing finding (load-bearing for Margaret natal family)

**14 Jun 1877 — human-eyes verified:**

> Die 14[to]: Honoria, filia Jacobi Moloney et **Honoriæ Quaid**. Spons[ores] **Davide Quaid** et **Margarita Gleeson**. Joannes Quinlan CC

Sponsors are David Quaid + Margarita Gleeson (note: one AI pass misread "Davide" as "Daniel"; human eyes is the lock).

→ **Margarita Gleeson sponsoring James Moloney + Honoria Quaid's daughter** = strong T2 evidence that James Moloney is Margaret's brother. Combined with Patrick Gleeson's probable sponsorship of the same couple's son Joannes on 17 Feb 1881 (p.125), this is reciprocal Gleeson-Moloney sponsorship across 4 yrs. See [[gleeson-james-moloney-margaret-brother]].

→ **David Quaid** is almost certainly Honoria Quaid's father (namesake-grandfather pattern). New Quaid kin-network lead.
